name: crosswake
description: Private, dependency-free repo-root manifest. It exists ONLY so bare-specifier and local-path resolution work for the Node built-in test runner (and for adopters wiring priv/static/crosswake.esm.js through a bundler). Nothing here is published: publishing the hook to a second package registry would open a second version axis and reproduce the documented client/native drift failure the library-owned choice exists to avoid (D-30, D-31). It is deliberately NOT in mix.exs's hex files allowlist.
